gaps: Pre-2000 NAIA seasons (incl. 1997 NAIA runner-up and 2003 is covered): NAIA week-by-week ratings PDF starts in 2000; no pre-2000 poll archive found on naia.org, Wayback, or athletics.biola.edu (story archive starts 2006).

NAIA points/records per week only for 2007 final and 2011-2016 (from archived naia.org releases); 2000-2010 weekly rows have rank only (from NAIA week-by-week PDF). Weekly NAIA releases for 2006-2010 were not captured by the Wayback Machine.

NAIA postseason (post-tournament) polls for 2000-2010 not found. The NAIA PDF's last column for those years is the final regular-season poll. (Postseason polls captured: 2011 No. 5, 2012 No. 4, 2013 No. 2, 2014 No. 3, 2015 No. 5, 2016 No. 14.)
NAIA 'receiving votes' appearances before 2011 are not reliably recoverable (PDF lists only top-25 ranks); only 2006 preseason RV found (Biola news).
2017 (first NCAA DII provisional year): all AVCA DII weekly polls archived; Biola not ranked or receiving votes. PacWest preseason pick 9th (conference poll, not included).

2018 AVCA DII RV appearances come from Biola news only (AVCA weekly pages for 2018 not archived except 9/3/2018, where Biola is absent); points only for the Nov. 12 poll (16). Final 12/3/2018 poll RV status unknown.

2019 AVCA DII: only preseason (8/20) and final (12/16) polls archived - Biola absent from both; in-season weeks unverified. 2019 NCAA West Region rankings (first year eligible) not found; Biola finished 17-13, unlikely top 10.
2020 season canceled (COVID); spring 2021 AVCA DII polls archived (Feb-Apr 2021) with no Biola entry.
2021 AVCA: Aug. 30 poll (Week 1) not archived. 2022 AVCA: Sept. 26 archived page is blank; all other 2022 weeks checked (Biola RV only preseason-Week 3).

NCAA DII West Region rankings: found Biola only in 2021 (No. 10 in all three editions, via opponent SID stories). 2022, 2023 (Nov. 8 list checked - not in top 10), 2024 (list checked - not in top 10) and 2025 (final Nov. 16 list on ncaa.com - not in top 10; NCAA selection-data sheet shows region RPI rank 13, not a published ranking) do not include Biola; earlier 2023/2022 editions not all verified.
2024 and 2025 AVCA DII: every weekly poll page on avca.org checked - Biola not ranked or receiving votes.
2026 season in progress: AVCA polls through Week 5 (Sept. 28) captured; Biola's first-ever AVCA DII Top 25 ranking (No. 25). Future weeks and 2026 regional rankings not yet released.
NCCAA polls (2017-2018 dual membership) only via Biola news; NCCAA site archives not searched in depth. Weekly NCCAA ranks/points unknown.
AVCA 'Others receiving votes' lists only teams on two or more ballots; single-ballot votes are not itemized, so an unlisted Biola may still have received a single-ballot vote.
